pr.title: Round discounts down
pr.body: Customers should never get more than the advertised discount.

labels.goal: Changes the discount rounding rule from nearest to down.
keyBehaviorChanges: The discounted price can no longer go below zero.

json.goal: Round discounts down to the whole cent.
behavior_changes: Discounts are rounded down instead of to the nearest cent.
